name: @ets/gelato
description: Gelato Web3 Functions for ETS event processing

scripts.test:target-enrichment: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-run target-enrichment --logs
scripts.test:tag-created: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-run tag-created --logs
scripts.deploy:target-enrichment:staging: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-deploy target-enrichment --network baseSepolia
scripts.deploy:target-enrichment:prod: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-deploy target-enrichment --network base
scripts.deploy:tag-created:staging: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-deploy tag-created --network baseSepolia
scripts.deploy:tag-created:prod: cd ../../packages/contracts && pnpm exec hardhat w3f-deploy tag-created --network base
